name: paper_validation_prep_80pct
comment: Select the same cell that will be used for 04b. Charge at 0.5C to its max_v, rest 30 min, then discharge at 0.2C for at most 3600s to remove approximately 20% of nominal capacity and rest 30 min. The cell's min_v remains the voltage backstop. Run 04b immediately afterward. If the current is capped or the voltage cutoff is reached early, the resulting starting SOC will not be 80%; verify the CSV before using the validation result.
